title: Medication Authorization Medical Authorization Form
subtitle: An original operational medical authorization for medication authorization that connects identity, evidence, authority, exceptions, privacy, and accountable closeout.
description: This Medication Authorization Medical Authorization Form supports the complete medication authorization workflow from intake and routing through evidence, authorized decisions, exception ownership, qualified review, and final handoff.
use_case: Use the Medication Authorization Medical Authorization Form when the assigned medication record coordinator needs one fillable record for supplied medication directions, custody, administration authority, exceptions, and handoff without inventing legal, medical, safety, consent, certification, or professional authority.

sections.title: Medication authorization medical authorization identity and routing
sections.guidance: Connect this medical authorization to one supplied medication directions, custody, administration authority, exceptions, and handoff record, an accountable owner, and the current review route.

blocks.label: Medication authorization record reference
blocks.guidance: Use the approved roster or case reference rather than creating a second identity.

blocks.label: Participant and responsible route
blocks.guidance: Record references and routing information only; keep sensitive details in approved systems.

blocks.label: Medication authorization scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

fields.label: Scope, trigger, prior handoff, and known limitations

sections.title: Medication authorization authorized health source and operating scope
sections.guidance: Transcribe supplied directions exactly and keep diagnosis or clinical interpretation out of this record.

blocks.label: Authorization and qualified source
Medication authorization supplied health and response information
items: Guardian authorization source and effective period
Qualified prescriber or health-plan direction reference
Medication name and label exactly as supplied
Dose, route, timing, and condition exactly as supplied
Student-specific stop or response instructions from the approved plan
Authorized staff, self-carry status, and administration setting
Emergency services, guardian contact, and qualified review route
Private storage, documentation, update, and handoff requirements

blocks.label: Authorized item, exact supplied direction, applicability, source, and review
Medical and authorization boundary
blocks.guidance: This form records medication authorization and custody; it does not prescribe, interpret, change, or guess a medication, dose, route, timing, diagnosis, or response. Use only current guardian authorization and qualified directions under applicable policy. Stop administration on any mismatch or uncertainty, use emergency services when indicated, protect privacy, and route decisions to qualified authorized staff.

sections.title: Medication authorization custody, staff readiness, and read-back
sections.guidance: Confirm the approved source, staff authority, setting, storage, and handoff before use.

blocks.label: Custody and authorized operating route
Medication authorization authorization readiness
items: Medication record is tied to the correct student identity
Guardian authorization source and effective period are recorded
Qualified directions are legible, current, and linked
Medication label, container, and record references reconcile
Authorized staff, setting, timing, and custody limits are explicit
Storage, access, expiration, and return arrangements are recorded
Student self-carry or self-administration status comes from an approved source
Symptoms, response steps, and emergency route come from the current plan
Privacy and minimum-necessary access are defined
Missing, changed, or disputed information stops administration and routes review

blocks.label: Item or record custody, condition, count, owner, and evidence
Exact read-back, unresolved mismatch, staff limitation, and qualified-review question

fields.label: Read-back, mismatch, staff limitation, and review question

sections.title: Medication authorization response conditions, stop controls, and decision
sections.guidance: Do not guess or improvise; stop and use the documented escalation route on any mismatch.

blocks.label: Conditions requiring hold, stop, or escalation
items: Student, medication, label, or authorization record does not match
Qualified direction is missing, illegible, expired, or changed
Required dose, route, timing, or condition cannot be confirmed from the approved source
Medication is unavailable, damaged, contaminated, or outside storage requirements
Authorized staff or required administration setting is unavailable
Student refuses, misses, vomits, or has an unexpected response
Immediate illness, reaction, overdose concern, or emergency response is active
Administration, inventory, custody, or guardian handoff does not reconcile

blocks.label: Condition, observed fact, immediate action, contact, and outcome
Medication authorization operating decision
blocks.guidance: Record the authorized decision under current policy; this form does not grant authority to the preparer. Route uncertainty to the guardian, qualified health professional, and authorized medication administrator.

blocks.label: Decision basis, source consulted, temporary limit, and next qualified review

fields.label: Decision basis, source, temporary limit, and qualified review

sections.title: Medication authorization exceptions, notification, and follow-up
sections.guidance: Preserve unknowns, assign correction, and record the accountable recipient.

blocks.label: Authorization and response exceptions
items: Medication administration cannot proceed from the current record
Guardian authorization or qualified direction is incomplete
Student, medication, label, dose, route, timing, or condition does not reconcile
Authorized staff, storage, supply, or required setting is unavailable
Immediate reaction, overdose concern, illness, or emergency response is active
Administration, inventory, custody, or guardian handoff remains unresolved

blocks.label: Exception, evidence or action needed, owner, due point, and disposition
Guardian, qualified reviewer, emergency, program, and receiving-staff notification handoff

fields.label: Notification sequence, facts shared, instructions received, and handoff

sections.title: Medication authorization outcome, closeout, and accountable handoff
sections.guidance: Make the final outcome, remaining limitation, next action, owner, and recipient visible.

blocks.label: Medication authorization closeout controls
items: Medication status and administration record accepted
Guardian and qualified-review communication recorded
Unresolved variance or follow-up has an owner
Medication and related equipment returned to approved custody
Emergency, health, pharmacy, or program follow-up linked
Medication record stored with privacy and retention requirements
blocks.guidance: Check only completed controls; preserve unresolved work as an open action.

blocks.label: Outcome and next action
Outcome verification, recipient acceptance, and reopen decision
Remaining limitation, action, owner, due point, and recipient route
blocks.guidance: Keep unresolved work visible until an accountable recipient accepts it.

blocks.label: Unresolved work, child or participant impact, evidence location, and handoff message

fields.label: Unresolved work, impact, evidence location, and handoff message

blocks.label: Medical Authorization closeout acknowledgment
blocks.guidance: Acknowledgment records preparation and receipt; it is not legal consent, medical certification, or professional approval.
